_note: A11 (2026-10-19 ET, D25 §1/§3) NPC sheets for Code. Rebuild PNGs: python3 make_npc_a11.py . (deterministic, Pillow, no RNG; verified byte-identical on rerun). @2x is exactly double; load @2x and draw at the 1x wu size.
keys: match D25 PED_TYPES keys: local, filmer, skater, krishna

frame.layout: single row, frame i at x = i*frame_w

anchor: frame centre (8,8 wu) = ped x,y (feet/body centre). Body ellipse ~5.8x8.8 wu (old rect 5x9), hit radius stays PED_HIT_R logic.
facing: +x at angle 0 (head toward +x, shoulders across y). Draw: ctx.translate(p.x,p.y); ctx.rotate(p.face); ctx.drawImage(sheet, i*64,0,64,64, -8,-8,16,16)

walk/gather/regroup.bob: Code applies D25 bob as y-offset/scale, not baked

cheer.fps: local/krishna: swap at bob rate (3 Hz local, 2.2 Hz krishna); D25 arms-up accent row; colour never changes

airborne.rotate: 720°/s spin (D25 §3.2), draw shadow per Code; scale 1.0→1.15→1.0 at peak optional

down.overlay: npc_stars frames 0,1,2 at 6 fps loop, centred 6 wu toward -x of ped (above head in sit pose), same rotation, alpha 1

getup.then: flee 1.2s (walk frames), immune until 0.5s after frame 13

type_notes.filmer: #F4F1EA body, phone #07080D held forward; idle/cheer0/cheer1 = phone raised. Frame 8 = phone pixel #FFFFFF lit. Flash: idle/filming toggles frames 6↔8 at 2 Hz (on 0.08s per 0.5s); cheer = 4 Hz (on 0.06s per 0.25s, D25). On each lit frame also draw npc_flash at the phone (+5 wu along facing), 12x12 wu, globalCompositeOperation 'lighter', alpha 0.55. White only, never a pad hue.
type_notes.skater: #4E8FE0 body, #20242E board along facing, grey #9AA0AB trucks. Frames 0-5 = push cycle (1-3 push foot out, 0/4/5 glide); during glide hold frame 0. Push every 0.8s: play 1,2,3 over 0.3s then hold 0. Hop (cheer) = frames 7,8 over 0.4s with scale 1.12 at mid. Down/getup frames show the board kicked aside.
type_notes.krishna: saffron #E9821E robe (wider ellipse), #F2D7B0 head with #07080D tuft dot. Line of 6, gap 14 wu: frame phase offset per follower = i (so the stride ripples like the D25 bob phase i*0.5 rad).

draw_order: world space: after pads/rings + locked decals + skids, before traffic/cops/car and before popups (same slot as today's crowd loop, PLAY-THIS ~L1986). Downed peds + stars draw in the same pass. Airborne peds draw after the car (they fly over it).
alpha_blend: source-over, alpha 1 (flash overlay: lighter 0.55). imageSmoothingEnabled true.

fallback_#C96A12.why_not: only +6 dE vs gold, loses ~30% luma on asphalt so the line reads weaker at z0.45
